rateLimits.note: Upload menu (PUT /menu/v1/brands/{brand_id}/menus/{id}): 1 a minute per site; menus over 5 MB also 10 requests per 10 seconds per integration partner.

provenance.notes: Contract-only: the Developer Portal serves Deliveroo's integration partners (a suite in the partner's contract, the account manager); no public API terms were found, hence rights "contract". Per-order limits the schema cannot count per order, not declared: PATCH /order/v1/orders/{id} (accept, deny) 5 a minute per order, and Deliveroo says it "should be called only once per order"; GET /order/v2/orders/{id} 1 a second per order (https://api-docs.deliveroo.com/reference/patch-order-1, https://api-docs.deliveroo.com/reference/get-order-v2). Webhooks may come more than once or out of order. No idempotency key on the order endpoints: Omnifood sends each once, never retried.
